meta.name: Minnum Oar Iravu
meta.description: Over a single night, five friends Kathir, Gilbert, Velu, Govind and Murugan stumble upon a wrecked car containing two dead bodies and a box of gold. Driven by greed, they hide the gold, split it among themselves, and go their separate ways.  But their decision triggers a deadly chain of events. Velu is murdered while trying to sell his share, followed by Gilbert. Kathir soon realizes that someone is hunting them down, one by one and the killer knows far more about them than he should.  Trapped in a race against time, Kathir must uncover the killer, protect the remaining friend, and survive until dawn. As the night closes in, he must confront not only a ruthless killer, but the consequences of their greed.
